derivation: patronymically from an unused name from H7762 (שׁוּם) probably meaning garlic-smell;
def: a Shumathite (collectively) or descendants of Shumah

occurrences.text: And the families of Kirjath–jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
